svg.title: Draft budget bill for 2027: what it asked of local authorities, and what is left of it
svg.desc: Amounts for 2027 of the five measures of the draft budget bill as tabled aimed at local authorities, in billions of euros: Progressive contribution (art. 37) 2.5; FCTVA, rate cut (art. 35) 2.1; Contributions from ministries 0.7; Assigned VAT, capping (art. 36) 0.6; DILICO, repayment spread out (art. 84) 0.3. Their arithmetic sum, 6.2, does not measure a net levy. Hollow bars: articles deleted or not adopted by the National Assembly on 19 October 2026; solid bars: measures not yet examined. State on 22 October 2026.
